channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Dozens killed in explosives depot blast in northeast Myanmar
item.description: At least 46 people have been killed and 70 wounded in explosion in rebel-held area, local media report.

item.title: Iran ⁠restores some gas production at South Pars facility
item.description: Production restored at three offshore platforms after Israeli attacks, Pars Oil and Gas Company CEO tells Iranian media.

item.title: Israel seizes castle in Lebanon as it expands ground offensive
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu calls the capture of the strategic fortress a "decisive shift" in Israel's campaign against Hezbollah, as European governments criticise the escalation.
